notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dwarves that don't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage using three Dwarves. Thorin's first ability triggers three times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them lifelink, trample and haste, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
